title: $100 a month into Starbucks since 1992 is now worth this
caption:
$100 every month into Starbucks since 1992.
Today that would be worth about {dca:SBUX:1992-06-26} (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: Could you put away $100 a month? 👇
sources: Starbucks price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: One hundred dollars a month, into Starbucks, starting in 1992.
Back then, Starbucks was a coffee chain.
Today, those monthly payments would be worth about {dca:SBUX:1992-06-26}.
Small, boring, every month. That's how wealth is built.
